newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-GOODS AND NON-FINANCIAL SECTOR GROWS 11.7 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-GOODS AND NON-FINANCIAL SECTOR GROWS 11.7 PCT.

text.p: The Estonian goods and non-financial sector in the first quarter of 1997 grew by 11.7 percent in constant prices compared to the first quarter of 1996, the statistics office said on Friday.
The goods and non-financial sector still dominates the structure of Estonian gross domestic product (GDP) producing 60.2 percent of total GDP, the office said in a statement.
The financial sector grew by 30 percent over the year, but still only accounts for 4.8 percent of total GDP.
The government sector's share of GDP increased from 11.9 percent in Q1 1996 to 12.9 percent in the first quarter of 1997.
